items.title: Tesla Stock Just Passed a Troubling Milestone
items.summary: Shares of the electric-vehicle maker were up 1.4% at $317.50 in premarket trading, while  and  futures were both up about 1%.  Tesla stock dropped 18% this past week, including a near-15% drop on Thursday after the company reported weaker-than-expected second-quarter results.  Coming into Monday trading, Tesla stock was down about 30% this year and down 5% over the past 12 months.
